_comment: S81 /generate-plan real-dispatch E2E (PII-free SYNTHETIC trainee, no real operator). A live personal-trainer dispatch (full profile inlined) authored this workout envelope for plan_date 2026-06-22 under clearance_granted=False (empty-clearance posture: effort prescribed by RIR, NO load/1RM, so the safety floor's load-drop is a no-op here). Fed through scripts/plan/pipeline.run_generation -> recorded plan::workout -> rendered on the dashboard. Proves the GENERATE leg is specialist-authored, not solo.

recommendations.claim: Volume is the primary driver of hypertrophy across the studied range, so anchoring the session on a horizontal pressing pattern at 3 hard sets contributes meaningful chest/triceps/anterior-deltoid stimulus.
recommendations.source: Schoenfeld et al. dose-response volume meta-analyses (resistance-trained adults)
recommendations.reversibility: Set count is freely adjustable session-to-session against measured response; no irreversible commitment.

payload.name: Barbell bench press
payload.detail: Stop each set at 1-2 RIR (no load/1RM prescribed pending clinician clearance); flat bench, full ROM, controlled eccentric.

recommendations.claim: Near-failure hypertrophy training is largely load-agnostic, so a vertical pull at 3-4 sets in a moderate rep range builds the lats and elbow flexors without requiring a prescribed load.
recommendations.source: Schoenfeld load comparison meta-analysis; near-failure load-agnostic finding (trained adults)
recommendations.reversibility: Rep range and assistance (band) are tunable each session; fully reversible.

payload.name: Pull-up (band-assisted as needed)
payload.detail: Stop at 1-2 RIR; add band assistance to keep reps in range; full hang to chin-over-bar.

recommendations.claim: A unilateral knee-dominant lower-body pattern at 3 sets per leg adds lower-body volume and movement balance within a four-day weekly distribution.
recommendations.source: Frequency-distributes-volume principle; unilateral loading literature (trained adults)
recommendations.reversibility: Step height and rep target adjust freely; reversible.

payload.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
payload.detail: Stop at 2-3 RIR; rear foot elevated on bench; control descent, drive through front heel.

recommendations.claim: A horizontal rowing pattern at 3 sets balances the session's pushing volume and trains the mid-back and elbow flexors near failure.
recommendations.source: Volume dose-response + push/pull balance heuristic (trained adults)
recommendations.reversibility: Dumbbell weight and tempo are tunable each session; reversible.

payload.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
payload.detail: Stop at 1-2 RIR; brace on bench, full stretch at bottom, drive elbow toward hip.

recommendations.claim: An isolation elbow-flexion movement at 3 sets in a higher rep range adds targeted biceps volume where compound pulls leave residual capacity, with proximity-to-failure as the effort lever.
recommendations.reversibility: Rep target and dumbbell load adjust session-to-session; reversible.

payload.name: Dumbbell incline curl
payload.detail: Stop at 0-1 RIR (isolation, low systemic fatigue); seated incline bench, full supinated ROM.
